LESSON: MOVEMENT OF MATERIALS IN AND OUT OF THE CELL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 2.2: Movement of Materials in and out of the cell

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Movement of Materials in and out of the cell
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do materials move in and out of a cell?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things
2. explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things
3. appreciate the importance of diffusion and osmosis in living things

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Movement of Materials in and out of the cell

Teach
• Observe Movement of Materials in and out of the cell in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Movement of Materials in and out of the cell (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Movement of Materials in and out of the cell.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Movement of Materials in and out of the cell.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Movement of Materials in and out of the cell.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things
• explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things
• appreciate the importance of diffusion and osmosis in living things

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Movement of Materials in and out of the cell.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Movement of Materials in and out of the cell: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do materials move in and out of a cell?

SECTION: REMEMBER
